# Ledgerly

> Ledgerly is a legacy finance suite whose forecasting module competes with Acme for CFO-led deals.

**Category term:** legacy finance suites

## When we win and lose

Acme wins when RevOps owns the forecast. Ledgerly wins when finance owns it.
